native_api: One unchanged Metal draw and native IOGPU submit/event-fence ticket; batching is internal to the A540 backend, with no public raw-IB interface or substitute Apple queue

encoding.primitive_boundary: Encoder checkpoints include PM4 command head, uploaded-data tail and reserved footer space. On capacity exhaustion roll back all commands/data for the current primitive, seal the preceding IB and retry the same primitive in a fresh buffer. Never post a partial logical draw.
encoding.shader_state: Each primitive retains complete native state. Reset the per-IB border-table address on rollover; retain monotonically increasing flush sequence values across all buffers and retries.
encoding.topology: existing immutable index snapshot/primitive iterator preserves triangle strips/restart/winding and instance order across buffer boundaries
encoding.footer: reserve two command DWORDs per IB for the existing wait-write/idle footer
encoding.single_primitive_limit: If one complete primitive and its attachment copies cannot fit an empty64 KiB IB, return NoResources before any GPU submission
encoding.stack: Separate primitive expansion from nonrecursive raster state emission; no repeated draw() stack frame

resources.collections: Apple OSArray retains the private QcomGPUBuffer objects; OSData owns the trusted immutable16-byte address/word-count descriptors
resources.snapshot_allocation_and_quota: existing16 MiB per allocation /64 MiB live snapshot budget unchanged and independent
resources.address_space: every command/code/constants IB mapped read-only in the same isolated job address space; existing index, scratch and user-resource permissions retained
resources.lifetime: all IB objects retained until real GPU retirement, or until a proved halt/drain on error; failed halt/address-space retirement retains/quarantines all command buffers
resources.command_snapshot: Single bounded OSData copy, at most2864 bytes, held only during CPU admission/encoding; replaces stacked command-array and shader-union copies

submission.ring_packets: all validated CP_INDIRECT_BUFFER_PFE calls appended at the same ring level; one enter-to-private and leave-to-kernel page-table pair
submission.ring_atomicity: validate every descriptor and entire ring capacity before changing published ring write pointer; no nested IB or per-chunk doorbell
submission.completion: one engine timestamp/IRQ after the final IB and kernel-table restoration; existing Family fence/end token and IOSurface publication occur only after that retirement
submission.allocation_failure: release staged buffers and quota without posting any part of the draw

watchdog.head_only: arm when a job becomes the monitored FIFO head, so time queued behind another job does not count as a GPU stall
watchdog.progress_source: CP-written UCHE flush sequence at the private scratch timestamp page, bounded by the final encoded sequence
watchdog.faults: out-of-range or backwards progress faults; no progress for500 ms times out; intermediate progress never advances a native completion token

abi: Native command, Shader36/JIT33, Surface metadata2, program/image and draw/dispatch sizes unchanged; private IB descriptors never cross the user/kernel boundary

evidence.scope: CPU checks of production encoder/ring/MMU fabric and actual A540 compiler output; not iOS Metal or A540 execution

remaining: per-primitive full-plane snapshot cost remains; coherent native tile fetch has not been established for A540
more native color formats, raster-order groups/imageblocks, native pipeline/function SPI, display shared fences/scanout and target execution
